use_case: Customer chatbot on the website and by text: answers repair questions, gives ticket status, books appointments, and gives price ranges from the price list
vendor_or_model: Chatbot vendor (generative language model with retrieval over the company's FAQ and price list; status lookups through the connector function)
data_categories: Customer questions; first name, ticket number, and status; anything customers type (sample found passcodes and card numbers)
consequential_decision_category: None (customer service); re-tier if it ever approves refunds, warranty or partner claims, or payment plans
human_in_the_loop: Staff take over on request, for complaints, and for any price outside the price list; the chatbot cannot change tickets or approve anything
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n) (claims, disclosure, data use); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) and (6) (chat data; vendor as third-party agent); PCI DSS v4.0.1 SAQ A and SAQ P2PE eligibility (card numbers typed into chat); Utah AI Policy Act as amended (Utah Code 13-72 and 13-75): disclose generative AI when a Utah customer clearly asks
status: In production since 2025-11; approved with conditions

use_case: AI-assisted diagnostics: analyzes device diagnostic logs and damage photos and suggests the likely fault and repair
vendor_or_model: Diagnostics vendor (machine learning model trained by the vendor on repair data)
data_categories: Device diagnostic logs (may include device name, account identifiers, and installed apps); photos of device damage
consequential_decision_category: None directly; influences what repair and price a customer is quoted and whether a partner claim is repaired or replaced
human_in_the_loop: Technician must inspect the device and record their own diagnosis before any quote; the customer approves the quote
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) (the "97% accurate" claim) and 45(n) (unneeded repairs); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) and (6); Partner agreements (accurate outcomes)
status: In production at the Depot and 20 stores since 2026-03; approved with conditions; no expansion until conditions are met

use_case: Contact center call transcription and AI summaries written into the SYS-01 ticket
vendor_or_model: Contact center platform AI add-on (speech-to-text and a generative language model)
data_categories: Call audio; transcripts; summaries with customer names, devices, and sometimes card numbers read out during phone payments
human_in_the_loop: Agent reviews and edits each summary before it is saved to the ticket
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) (all-party consent to interception); PCI DSS v4.0.1 3.2.1 and SAQ P2PE eligibility (card numbers in recordings and transcripts); FTC Act Section 5; Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) and (6)
status: In production since 2026-05; conditional (outbound recording stopped 2026-09-18)

use_case: Parts demand forecasting: predicts weekly part demand by store and suggests purchase orders
vendor_or_model: ERP vendor forecasting module (statistical and machine learning models)
data_categories: Parts usage, sales, and supplier lead times; no personal data
applicable_laws: None specific; contract terms with the ERP vendor

use_case: Applicant ranking in the applicant tracking system: scores and ranks applicants for technician and advisor roles
vendor_or_model: Applicant tracking system vendor feature (machine learning ranking against job requirements)
data_categories: Resumes; application answers; work history; home ZIP code; voluntary self-identification data held separately for EEO reporting
human_in_the_loop: Before 2026-09-18 recruiters reviewed only "recommended" applicants; auto-ranking paused 2026-09-18; recruiters now review all applicants who meet minimum qualifications
applicable_laws: Title VII, 42 U.S.C. 2000e-2(k) (disparate impact); Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures, 29 CFR 1607.4(D) (four-fifths rule of thumb); Fla. Stat. 760.10 (unlawful employment practices, including age); Colorado SB26-189 not expected to apply (hiring in Florida only)
status: Paused; may resume only on the conditions in the assessment (decision by the Chief Executive Officer)
